api.signIn.opening.where: Sign-in screen, right after the LINE sign-in screen while the app signs in to its server with LINE's ID token: the status line
api.signIn.opening.ja: シールボードをひらいています…

api.signIn.failed.where: Sign-in screen, when signing in to the app's server fails: the heading above the error's message and a Try again button
api.signIn.failed.ja: ログインできませんでした

api.signIn.tryAgain.where: Sign-in screen, after signing in to the app's server failed: the button that retries the sign-in

api.handle.title.where: Handle prompt, on a first sign-in whose LINE name is already someone's handle, before the app opens: the heading
api.handle.title.ja: ユーザー名を決めましょう

api.handle.lead.where: Handle prompt, when LINE gave no display name: the line under the heading
api.handle.lead.ja: みんながあなたやあなたのシールを見つけるときに使う名前です。

api.handle.leadNameTaken.where: Handle prompt, when the person's LINE display name ({{name}}) is already someone's handle: the line under the heading
api.handle.leadNameTaken.ja: @{{name}}はすでにほかの人が使っているので、あなただけのユーザー名を決めてください。みんながあなたやあなたのシールを見つけるときに使う名前です。

api.handle.field.where: Handle prompt: the handle input's accessible label, read by screen readers

api.handle.placeholder.where: Handle prompt: the placeholder in the empty handle input, after the @ icon

api.handle.tooLong.where: Handle prompt, while typing: the problem line under the input once the handle is longer than {{max}} characters

api.handle.taken.where: Handle prompt, after tapping Use @handle: the problem line when the server answers handle_taken
api.handle.taken.ja: @{{handle}}はすでに使われています。別のユーザー名をお試しください。

api.handle.invalid.where: Handle prompt, after tapping Use @handle: the problem line when the server answers handle_invalid
api.handle.invalid.ja: ユーザー名は「@」なしの1〜{{max}}文字です。

api.handle.couldntSave.where: Handle prompt, after tapping Use @handle: the problem line when saving fails any other way; {{reason}} is errorReason's message with the server's detail
api.handle.couldntSave.ja: ユーザー名を保存できませんでした：{{reason}}

api.handle.use.where: Handle prompt: the submit button once a handle is typed, naming it

api.handle.pick.where: Handle prompt: the submit button, disabled, while the handle input is empty

line.gate.opening.where: LINE sign-in screen, while LINE (LIFF) starts up as the app opens: the status line
line.gate.opening.ja: シールボードをひらいています…

line.gate.title.where: LINE sign-in screen, in a browser outside LINE before LINE Login: the heading
line.gate.title.ja: あなたのシールボード

line.gate.lead.where: LINE sign-in screen, in a browser outside LINE before LINE Login: the line under the heading
line.gate.lead.ja: LINEアカウントでひらきます。

line.gate.logIn.where: LINE sign-in screen, in a browser outside LINE: the button that starts LINE Login

line.gate.didntStart.where: LINE sign-in screen, when LINE (LIFF) fails to start or doesn't within 15 seconds: the heading
line.gate.didntStart.ja: LINEが起動しませんでした

line.gate.didntStartLead.where: LINE sign-in screen, when LINE (LIFF) fails to start: the line under the heading, above Try again and LINE's reason in fine print
line.gate.didntStartLead.ja: 起動すると、シールボードがひらきます。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。

line.gate.tryAgain.where: LINE sign-in screen, when LINE (LIFF) fails to start: the button that reloads the page
